decision.observation: The car has run off the top side of the tarmac into the grass at 3 mph in gear 1, facing into a dense pine treeline about a screen away. The road with its puddles lies directly behind and below the car, running lower-left to right.
decision.hypothesis: Plain throttle carried the car past the road into the trees. Since the road is directly behind, reversing straight (no steering) should drop the car back onto the tarmac without swinging it deeper into the forest.
decision.memory: At this junction plain W took the car straight over the road and onto the far grass into the treeline. Reversing without steering is the safest retreat when the road is squarely behind.
